selected_function.name: BRANCH
selected_function.description: Select a branch based on an explicit predicate

operator.name: ABSTRACT
operator.description: Change the subject's representation under an explicitly selected abstraction mode while preserving source traceability and recording intentionally omitted details.

invariants: Traceable ancestry of each enclosing solver
No promotion of inferred claims to direct user instructions
Meaningful change of reasoning level or representation

random_selection.note: Replay the complete ordered draw list for the exact source revision; frame choices are persisted once per frame.

requirements: Use atomic BRANCH (OP.01.012) inside the fixed higher-order frame ABSTRACT / IMPLEMENTATION. An opcode instruction is not execution evidence.
Apply the *same* higher-order choice as the other two slots of F0; do not reroll or switch modes.
Construct an explicit IMPLEMENTATION representation with its specified fields; IMPLEMENTATION describes mechanisms, not execution.
Supply preserved_properties, suppressed_details, introduced_assumptions, source_mapping, and next_solver_input in substantive output.
The enclosing frame receives the preceding solver or subject as an input with problem, method, assumptions, intermediate results, limitations and source references.
Preserve source mapping, referent identities, attribution and invariants; record suppressed details, introduced assumptions and unresolved questions.
Build a distinct new solver input or representation, not a paraphrase or an ungrounded claim of higher abstraction.
Add substantive development rather than a quotation ladder or paraphrase.
Append exactly one substantive scratchpad at index 3; retain the accepted prefix.
